events.title: Winning Was the Easy Part
events.summary: Winning Was the Easy Part Demockracy was always meant to have two halves: taking power, and keeping it. The second half is now in the game. You form a government and fill five ministries. You need 28 of 55 votes to pass a law. And the moment you have power, three institutions start watching you. Every MP has a price — and some prices come due later When you're short on votes, the whip room opens and you see the waverers and the opponents by name. events.title: The Election Night Update — Codex, 3 New Ideologies & Live Vote Counts
events.summary: The demo just got its biggest update yet. Here's what's new:🗳️ Election Night, ReimaginedElections are no longer a results screen — they're an event. The polls close, the screen goes dark, and a live broadcast begins: ballots are counted region by region, completed regions light up in the leading party's colors, and the count slows down as the final boxes open.
